profile.summary:
Embrace the process | Create and build
 
I’m a developer, designer, and AI builder with an eclectic background in architecture, lighting design, and building spaces.
 
That foundation trained me to shape experiences by balancing systems, details, and constraints. Today, I bring that same eye into software: building clean interfaces, useful tools, reusable components, and AI-powered workflows that make complicated things feel simple.
 
I love turning rough ideas into something clear, useful, and real.
 
Yes is core: start with possibility
Less is more: remove the noise and build what matters
 
Open to freelance projects with people and businesses who need practical development and solutions.

positions.title: Developer | Designer | Ai Builder
positions.description:
Yes is Core | Less is More

With a foundation in design, software development, and AI-driven workflows, I work at the intersection of creativity, technology, and practical problem solving.
 
I enjoy taking rough ideas, pressure-testing them from different angles, and turning them into clean, useful, user-focused solutions. Whether I’m designing an interface, building a reusable component system, automating a workflow, or exploring how AI can accelerate execution, my goal is always the same: make the complex feel simple.
 
My approach is guided by two principles:
 
Yes is Core
* Start with possibility. Explore broadly. Find the useful spark.
 
Less is More
* Refine relentlessly. Remove friction. Build only what serves the experience.
 
I’m especially interested in how AI can help teams move faster without sacrificing quality, taste, or clarity.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · JavaScript · Affinity Designer · Design Thinking · Revit · GitHub · GitHub Copilot · Anthropic Claude · ChatGPT · Agentic AI Development

positions.title: Associate Software Developer
positions.description:
Contract work for Dayforce | Software Developer
Environment: C#, .Net, EF, Blazor, Okta, Azure, Cosmos

Collaborating with fellow developers and product owners in an agile environment to create a web application to track and automate various documents and reports associated with payrolls.

positions.title: Lighting Designer
positions.description:
Project types included: hotels, casinos, restaurants, retail, offices, theatres, event centers, auditoriums, churches, as well as various public facilities.

Collaborated with architects, interior designers, electrical engineers, and general contractors to provide lighting design construction documents and fixture specifications to light indoor and outdoor spaces.

Participated in all stages of design from schematic design, to the development phase producing construction documents, through to the final installation phase and aiming of the light fixtures.

Created a variety of diagrams, renderings, presentation materials, and detailed drawings throughout the course of the project to visually communicate the lighting design direction with both the design team and the client. Additionally all light fixtures were 3D modeled in a shared Revit BIM model.

positions.title: Architectural Drafter
positions.description:
Communicated with colleagues (architects, engineers, project managers, contractors, ect.) to collect, process, and analyze building specs to produce a coherent and accurate set of construction documents - on time for installation.

Responsible for the material order for each project - attention to detail is critical so that budgets, timelines, and accurate materials are achieved thus minimizing waste.

Annotated plans, elevations, and their specific details during a project creating a clear and concise story for the installation team. These documents are integral to successfully complete every project.

positions.title: Freelance Designer
positions.description:
Design innovative materials for print, web, and brand identity by recognizing design problems and translating them into simple solutions.

Responsible for execution of product vision through collaborative analysis and implementation.

Interpret and improvise the client specifications and constraints to creatively produce designs that satisfy expectations.

positions.title: Grocer
positions.description: Unloaded trucks, stocked shelves, organized displays, and provided customer service for anyone who needed assistance.

positions.title: Seed Researcher
positions.description:
Assisted in the fields and around the shop as needed.
Seed Research, Irrigation, detasseling, pollinating, shop / grounds maintenance, and other typical farm shit.

organizations.name: Freedom By Design
organizations.description:
Participated in a full-scale architectural project which utilized a hands-on approach that included
the process of conceptualizing sketches to completion of construction. 

Collaborated with students and community officials to successfully execute architectural designs within the community.

organizations.name: American Institute of Architecture Students
organizations.description:
Appointed to position by peer-members of AIAS.

Increased membership by 15 percent through advertising and promoting benefits of the
organization to perspective members.

Responsibilities entailed the production of event signage, communication with current and
perspective members via social media, as well as the practice of grass-root marketing.

Attended national AIAS forums to participate in workshops, network with others, and to gain
knowledge of impending industry alternatives.
